title: 12 Best Art Galleries in Chengdu
description: Discover Chengdu's vibrant art scene! Explore the top 12 art galleries, from contemporary masterpieces to traditional Sichuan crafts, with insider tips and pricing for your cultural journey.

places.name: MOCA Chengdu (Museum of Contemporary Art Chengdu)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Check their website for current special exhibitions; they often host groundbreaking installations and new media art that are truly unique.

places.name: A4 Art Museum (A4美术馆)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Explore the outdoor sculptures and installations around Luxelakes after visiting the main museum. The integration of art and nature is a key highlight.

places.name: Sichuan Museum (四川博物院)
places.priceRange: Free (some special exhibits may charge CNY 20-50 ($3-7))
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Don't miss the Zhang Daqian Art Gallery, featuring works by the renowned modern Chinese painter, a native of Sichuan.

places.name: Blue Roof Art Village (蓝顶艺术区)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Visit the smaller, independent galleries within the village; you might discover emerging talents or unique pieces not found elsewhere.

places.name: Chengdu East Music Park (东郊记忆 - Eastern Suburb Memory)
places.priceRange: Free (some specific events/galleries may charge CNY 20-50 ($3-7))
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Look for the large-scale murals and sculptures scattered throughout the park, offering fantastic photo opportunities.

places.name: Chengdu Museum (成都博物馆)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pre-book your tickets online well in advance, especially for popular temporary exhibitions, as they can sell out quickly.

places.name: Zanadu Art Center (赞那度艺术中心)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Check their social media for current exhibition details, as they frequently rotate shows, sometimes with immersive elements.

places.name: Wuliangye Art Center (五粮液艺术中心)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Before visiting, check their schedule for upcoming events; you might catch a major international art show or a unique cultural festival.

places.name: Kuanzhai Alley Art Galleries (宽窄巷子内艺术空间)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Look for galleries featuring Shu embroidery (蜀绣), an intricate and world-renowned needlework tradition unique to Sichuan.

places.name: The MIXC Art Center (万象城艺术中心)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Enjoy the convenience of combining art viewing with shopping and dining. It’s perfect for a relaxed afternoon.

places.name: ARTISANAL. Gallery (手作·艺廊)
places.priceRange: Free to browse (workshops or special exhibits may charge CNY 30-80 ($4-11))
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Look for unique, handmade ceramics or small art prints that reflect local Chengdu culture and craftsmanship.

places.name: Dayuan Art Museum (大源美术馆)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Explore the works of emerging local artists featured here, as it offers a glimpse into Chengdu's burgeoning art talent.
